notes: Every node is its own record Node(Node left, Node right) on the garbage-collected heap; leaves have null children.
Default JVM ergonomics pick the collector: G1 with several CPUs, Serial GC when the container is pinned to one (-cpuset 1). Dropped trees die young; the long-lived tree is promoted.
Recursive build and check, JIT-compiled by C2; the few output lines go through a 64 KiB BufferedOutputStream over FileDescriptor.out.
Digits are checked explicitly because Integer.parseInt also accepts a leading '+'.
